Input:ClaimsSummary.title: Claims Summary
Input:ClaimsSummary.description: Full name of the account holder (e.g. "Kiran Singh"). Used to address the customer in the briefing.

Input:PolicySummary.title: Policy Summary
Input:PolicySummary.description: Formatted list of the customer's recent and open service cases, including subject, status, and reported date. Passed from the Get Insurance Claims action.

Input:CustomerName.title: Customer Name
Input:CustomerName.description: Formatted list of the customer's active insurance policies, including policy type, premium amount, and expiration date. Passed from the Get Insurance Policies action.

outputLanguage.title: Output language
outputLanguage.description: Optional. Specify the response language using the appropriate two-character language code or five-character locale code (for example, en_US, en_GB, es, es_MX).
